sources.title: Percy Liang on the Center for Research on Foundation Models' First (and Next) 30 Years
sources.quote_checked: The center was formed around this idea that we had a lot to offer | evaluate and benchmark and document what's happening | We need a nutrition label or a spec sheet for these objects that we're selling or people are buying and using. | It should be something that's really decentralized and governed in a much more decentralized way. | I hope that CRFM will be a respectable player in terms of shaping the norms around how these technologies are built.

sources.title: Stanford Professor Discusses Exciting Advances in Foundation Model Evaluation
sources.quote_checked: We released HELM about a year ago. It stands for holistic evaluation of language models. | You should think about HELM as a framework for evaluation, where you can come with a particular evaluation dataset | It's holistic because we try to look at all of these different dimensions, scenarios, and about 30 separate models and evaluate systematically. | We started with language models, but now we're moving to multimodal models as well. | We hope to populate HELM with a wide variety of benchmarks that enterprises would care about.
